context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useWishlist SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce. Tests knowledge of the hook's includeProducts parameter, the authentication requirement (customerId auto-fetched from useCustomer), the isEmpty computed property, and proper rendering for unauthenticated, loading, empty, and populated wishlist states.

checklist.name: Uses useWishlist hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useWishlist from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce.

checklist.name: includeProducts parameter
checklist.description: The hook is called with { includeProducts: true } so product details are included in wishlist items.

checklist.name: isEmpty property used
checklist.description: The component uses the isEmpty property from wishlist data (not manually checking lineItems.length).

checklist.name: isLoading handling
checklist.description: A loading state is shown while the wishlist data is being fetched.

checklist.name: Unauthenticated state
checklist.description: When no customer data is available, the component renders an appropriate sign-in prompt.
